# Default controller bindings

<!-- Generated by tools/Write-ControllerControlsReference.ps1 from the distributed binding graphs. -->

These are the current source defaults shared by the three games. SteamVR can retain a different saved custom layout. In Overture use **Options > Controls > Controller bindings (SteamVR)**; in Black Plague use **Options > VR Settings > Controller bindings (SteamVR)**. Requiem uses the SteamVR dashboard binding editor. The in-game shortcuts are host-tested v1.0.3 changes; their dashboard presentation still needs headset validation.

Stick deflection supplies a Vector2 Position action; stick press supplies a separate boolean Click. Turning does not toggle crouch unless the stick is pressed. Button crouch is a toggle in Button/Hybrid mode; Physical mode uses headset height.

Index grip and trackpad presses use force with explicit 0.65 activation / 0.60 release thresholds, following Valve Moondust. Touch/Pico recenter is deliberately unassigned to avoid stealing a gameplay button or naming a nonexistent button; use the calibration menu where available or assign a custom SteamVR binding.

The offhand trigger is activated for interaction by Overture. Black Plague/Requiem currently activate the dominant gameplay set only. Vive/WMR retain compatibility layouts: the Overture offhand trigger can also activate Jump; Vive menu clicks also recenter. Those legacy exceptions are listed here rather than treated as full controller parity. Device validation remains in the [controller ledger](TRILOGY_PARITY_PLAN.md#controller-profiles-and-distribution).

## Windows Mixed Reality (holographic)

SteamVR type: `holographic_controller`. Default file: `holographic_controller.json`.

| Gameplay action | Right-handed | Left-handed |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Move | Left stick deflection | Right stick deflection |
| Sprint | Left stick press | Right stick press |
| Turn | Right stick deflection | Left stick deflection |
| Toggle crouch | Right stick press | Left stick press |
| Interact/use tool | Right trigger press | Left trigger press |
| Quick light | Left grip press | Right grip press |
| Inventory | Right grip press | Left grip press |
| Notebook | Left menu press | Right menu press |
| Holster | Not assigned | Not assigned |
| Examine | Right menu press | Left menu press |
| Jump | Left trigger press | Right trigger press |
| Pause | Right trackpad press | Right trackpad press |
| Recenter | Left trackpad press | Left trackpad press |

| UI action | Right-handed | Left-handed |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Select | Left trigger press / Right trigger press | Left trigger press / Right trigger press |
| Drag/alternate | Right stick press | Left stick press |
| Back/context | Right menu press | Left menu press |
| Close | Left menu press / Right grip press | Left grip press / Right menu press |
| Recenter | Left trackpad press | Left trackpad press |
